method: Original-only full-scene sheets for every image, then native-pixel crops; current effective labels/mappings consulted afterwards. Repeated fixed geometry helps surface identity but never proves hidden coordinates or occupancy. No model inference, GPU run, or tracked edits.
manual_ranges_note: Pixel ranges are visual annotation uncertainty, not numerical serialization tolerance. A nominee is not accepted until root independent adjudication. No held field is silently certified.
